verdict.rationale: Salv's OpenAPI spec lets API users pick a dedicated `demo` Sandbox environment separate from `app` Production, which delivers the core of testing against a sandbox without touching production. Its scenario backtesting also runs rule versions against historical data 'with no real alerts', so rule changes can be tested without production side effects. missing for 10: documentation of sandbox provisioning/credentials, sandbox data isolation and seeding of test data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
